# `get_camera_img`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Fetch the current camera image as a binary transfer.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build same handler flow on a different camera-driver backend (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | D |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, imager handler @0x113620 (64-bit build), ReadCamImg @0x2136c0 (64-bit, ASI_CAM_GetImage/GetImageCrop, wide-denoise and S30Plus/S80 branches); 32-bit closure uses ASICAM_* / v4l2 with hpct/raw conversion instead |

Params are not consumed. Registered in the imager image table of both builds; the response is the current camera image as uncompressed raw (dataType 2) or the text "there is no image now", not ordinary command JSON. READ. The 32-bit build follows the same handler flow over a different camera-driver backend and lacks the 64-bit wide-camera denoise and newer-model branches (READ). Acknowledgement semantics are unresolved.

Side effects: Reads the camera image; reallocates the retained camera image object (a cache effect) and logs diagnostics on crop-read failure or frame mismatch. Full camera and ISP descendants are not bounded.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_camera_img"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Not read. Omission, null, object, scalar and array all take the same path. Clients SHOULD omit it. [READ] |
